chunks: From him, from Abdullah ibn Jabala, from Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from Abu Baseer, similar to that. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Moalla ibn Muhammad, from one of his companions, from Aban, from Ismail ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Ju'fi, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him (peace be upon him).
Regarding a woman who died and left her husband, he said: 'The wealth is for the husband,' meaning if there is no other inheritor for her besides him.
ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of a husband if his wife dies leaving no other heirs?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi, transmitted through the chain of Aban ibn Taghlib, clarifies the principle of 'exclusive inheritance' (al-mirath al-khalis) where the husband inherits the entirety of his deceased wife's estate in the absence of descendants or ascendants. This ruling highlights the distinct Shia jurisprudential position that the husband is the sole heir in this specific scenario, distinguishing it from cases where other relatives might share the estate. The hadith underscores the completeness of the husband's right to the wealth when no other Quranic heirs are present.
